title: DecisionStatus
description: The safe public status surface of the optional decision layer (master plan 14.2, operations): which provider and model are configured, in what mode, how often the layer fell back and why, and how many results were accepted and rejected. It is a read-only operational view and never an authorisation result: it carries no thresholds, gates, candidate data, scores, tenant data, keys or any other authority internals, and no counter can be read as permission to do anything.

mode.description: off: the layer is disabled and every flow runs through the controller. shadow: the scorer runs and is recorded but its result is never used. advisory: gated results may inform the interpretation path; the deterministic adapter still re-resolves every selection.

model_id.description: The configured scorer model. Absent when none is configured.

model_revision.description: The pinned revision of the configured model. Absent when none is configured.

accepted_count.description: Results whose disposition was accepted since the counters started.

rejected_count.description: Results whose disposition was fallback since the counters started: the sum of fallback_counts.

fallback_counts.description: One entry per fallback reason that occurred since the counters started, at most one entry per reason.

since.description: When the counters started (process start or last reset).

fallbackCount.description: How many results fell back for one reason.

count.description: Number of results that fell back for this reason.
